entries.review: Native table/raster identical in PC and Amiga; reuse the exact immutable C01 master image, but export separate target derivatives inside the native 0x30 box to keep low-locomotion scale coherent with F1/F2. The accepted B0 fall derivatives remain unchanged. Action, height, frame, clocks and shadow policy remain engine-owned. Internal delegated review, not new human visual acceptance.

Explicit delegated review: same compact unarmed body, direction and pose in the complete PC/Amiga metadata and private native raster; painted master already created for this exact silhouette. Actual CF1 fall producer selects B0-B7/F0. Reuse body RGBA only; action, height, crop, independent native shadow, ordering and clocks stay engine-owned. No ground shadow added and no claim of human acceptance.
